name: Apache Tomcat
description: The Apache Tomcat app is a unified logs and metrics app that helps you monitor the availability, performance, health and resource utilization of your Apache Tomcat servers. Preconfigured dashboards provide insight into visitor locations, traffic patterns, errors, resource utilization, garbage collection, web server operations and access from known malicious sources.
